set system host-name [parameter1].explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: Interface name, e.g., g-1/0/0.

unit [parameter2] family inet address [p.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit number to distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

parameters.name: subnet-mask
parameters.explanation: Bits of IPv4 subnet mask.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit number to distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

parameters.name: autonomous-system
parameters.explanation: Autonomy system number for equipment, used for route agreements such as BGP.

set protocols bgp group [parameter1].explanation: This command configures a BGP group named [parameter1], defining a set of BGP peers with shared session parameters.

parameters.name: group
parameters.explanation: BGP Group name.

type [parameter2].explanation: Configure the type of BGP group to be external.

parameters.name: type
parameters.explanation: Type of BGP group, e.g. external.

peer-as [parameter2].explanation: Configures the peer autonomy system number for BGP groups.

parameters.name: peer-as
parameters.explanation: Equivalent Autonomy System Number.

neighbor [parameter2].explanation: Configure the neighbors of the BGP team.

parameters.name: neighbor
parameters.explanation: Neighbor's IP address.

family [parameter2] [parameter3].explanation: Configure BGP protocol settings for a specific group, specifying the address family and type

parameters.name: address family
parameters.explanation: The address family to configure (e.g., inet)

parameters.name: type
parameters.explanation: The type of the address family (e.g., unicast)

export [parameter2].explanation: Configure the BGP group using the specified export policy.

parameters.name: export-policy
parameters.explanation: Name of the export policy.

set policy-options policy-statement [par.explanation: This command fragment defines a routing policy named `[parameter1]` in Junos, allowing you to configure specific routing rules, actions, and conditions for traffic control.

parameters.name: policy-statement
parameters.explanation: name of the policy statement.

term [parameter2] from route-filter [par.explanation: Configure the matching conditions for the policy statement.

parameters.name: term
parameters.explanation: The term number of the policy statement.

parameters.name: route-filter
parameters.explanation: The network address of the route filter.

parameters.name: subnet-mask
parameters.explanation: The number of subnet bits of the route filter.

parameters.name: match-type
parameters.explanation: Match type, for example.

term [parameter2] then [parameter3].explanation: Configure the action for the policy statement.

parameters.name: term
parameters.explanation: The term number of the policy statement.

parameters.name: action
parameters.explanation: Action type, for example.
